features.description: Auth middleware: API key validation on all embed service endpoints
steps: Add API key middleware to FastAPI app (X-API-Key header)
Load expected key from .env (EMBED_SERVICE_API_KEY)
Return 401 on missing/invalid key, 200 on valid
Health endpoint exempt from auth (for monitoring)
Run tests to verify auth blocks unauthenticated requests

features.description: Rate limiting: per-IP request throttling on embed service
steps: Add slowapi or similar rate limiter
Default: 60 requests/minute per IP
Return 429 Too Many Requests when exceeded
Run test confirming rate limit triggers

features.description: Request logging: structured access logs with IP, endpoint, status
steps: Add middleware logging each request (IP, path, status, latency)
Log to services/embed/logs/ directory
Verify logs capture both successful and rejected requests

features.description: Embed service starts on localhost and passes health check
steps: Activate venv, run uvicorn
Curl localhost:8766/health returns 200
Verify Gemini API key (new project claude-code-gws-cli-489903) works
Embed a test string, get 3072-dim vector back

features.description: Pinecone connectivity: verify index accessible and has existing data
steps: Query hivefind-memory-v2 index stats
Run a test query, get results
Verify metadata fields match MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE.md schema

features.description: ngrok tunnel with auth: re-expose embed service securely
steps: Start ngrok tunnel to localhost:8766
Verify unauthenticated request to public URL returns 401
Verify authenticated request (with API key header) returns 200
Test from external network (curl from different context)

features.description: Launchd daemons: re-enable embed + ngrok as managed services
steps: Update plist files with new config (auth-enabled)
Load daemons via launchctl
Verify both services survive reboot simulation (unload/load)
Verify crash-loop protection (no KeepAlive without backoff)

features.description: Test suite: unit + integration tests for embed service
steps: Write tests for auth middleware (valid key, invalid key, missing key)
Write tests for rate limiting
Write tests for embed endpoints (text, file, multimodal)
Write tests for ingest and query endpoints
Run pytest -v, all pass with 80%+ coverage

features.description: n8n workflow update: add API key header to all HTTP requests hitting embed service
steps: Update Evelyn_01_MemoryIngestion webhook to include X-API-Key
Update Evelyn_02_MemoryQuery webhook to include X-API-Key
Update EmailToNotion_InboxProcessor HTTP nodes
Test each workflow end-to-end with authenticated requests

features.description: Notion cleanup: archive ~80 empty entries from failed workflow iterations
steps: Query Email Inbox DB for entries with empty Subject/From
Archive or delete empty entries via Notion API
Verify only valid entries remain (should be 2)

features.description: Calendar sync: activate CalendarToNotion workflow in n8n
steps: Load CalendarToNotion_EventSync workflow into n8n cloud
Configure Google Calendar credential
Set 15-minute sync interval
Create a test calendar event
Verify event appears in Notion Calendar Events DB

features.description: Attendee extraction: parse Google Calendar attendee list into Notion
steps: Add Code node to extract attendee name, email, responseStatus
Store attendee details in Calendar Events DB properties
Test with multi-attendee event
Verify attendee data populates correctly

features.description: Email ingestion end-to-end: label email, verify it flows through to Notion + Pinecone
steps: Label a real email with process-with-ai
Wait for 5-min cycle to pick it up
Verify entry in Notion Email Inbox DB
Verify embedding stored in Pinecone (query by email subject)
Verify labels updated (hivefind-processed added, process-with-ai removed)

features.description: Memory query: ask a question, get relevant email context back
steps: POST to /query with a natural language question
Get back ranked matches from Pinecone
Verify results include metadata (agent, domain, timestamps)
Verify semantic relevance (query about X returns emails about X)

features.description: Query/response workflow: user question -> memory lookup -> LLM summary
steps: Create n8n workflow: webhook input -> embed query -> Pinecone search -> Claude API summarize
Include Notion explicit preferences in context
Test with real question about stored emails
Verify response is coherent and cites source emails

features.description: Calendar prep workflow: pre-meeting attendee research brief
steps: Create n8n workflow: triggered 1hr before meetings
Look up attendees in memory (past interactions, preferences)
Generate brief with attendee context + meeting agenda
Deliver to Notion or email

features.description: Daily summary workflow: evening digest of calendar + pending items
steps: Create n8n workflow: triggered at 8 PM ET daily
Aggregate tomorrow's calendar events
List pending/unprocessed items from email inbox
Generate summary via Claude API
Deliver to Notion daily log

features.description: Memory review queue: user can approve/reject memories before Pinecone storage
steps: Create Notion Memory Review Queue DB (if not exists)
Route new memories to queue instead of direct Pinecone insert
Add approve/reject status field
On approve: embed and store to Pinecone
On reject: archive in Notion, skip Pinecone

features.description: Preference capture: explicit user preferences stored in Notion
steps: Create Explicit Preferences DB in Notion
Seed with known preferences (flight times, meeting limits, etc.)
Wire preferences into query/response workflow context
Test: query where preference should influence response

features.description: Session chaining: Runway calls >5 minutes auto-chain to new sessions
steps: Detect session approaching 5-min limit
Auto-initiate new session with context carryover
User experience is seamless (no visible break)
Test with 8-minute conversation

features.description: Recording: save Runway video call recordings to Notion
steps: Capture session recording from Runway SDK
Upload to cloud storage (S3 or GCS)
Create Notion entry with recording link, duration, transcript summary
Test: complete a call, verify recording appears in Notion

features.description: Mobile responsive: Runway agents app works on phone screens
steps: Add responsive CSS/layout to runwayagents Next.js app
Test on iPhone viewport (375px)
Verify video call controls accessible on mobile
Verify text chat readable on small screens

features.description: HeyGen retirement: remove HeyGen dependencies, fully switch to Runway
steps: Identify all HeyGen references in codebase
Remove HeyGen API keys and configs
Update persona assets to Runway-only
Verify no HeyGen calls remain

features.description: Agent roster expansion: activate remaining 18 agents in Runway
steps: Create Runway Characters for each agent using spec personality
Configure voice profiles per agent
Add to agent registry in runwayagents app
Test 3 representative agents (one per domain cluster)

features.description: Correction processing: capture human overrides as high-value memories
steps: Create n8n workflow triggered when user edits/corrects an agent output
Extract correction context (what was wrong, what's right)
Store as correction-type memory with 0.95 confidence
Verify correction influences future queries

features.description: Weekly consolidation: Evelyn synthesizes patterns from week's memories
steps: Create n8n workflow: triggered Sunday 11 PM
Query all memories from past 7 days
Use Claude API to identify patterns and trends
Generate consolidation report to Notion
Promote validated patterns to explicit knowledge

features.description: GCP budget monitoring: verify killswitch and alerts still active
steps: Check Cloud Function billing killswitch is deployed
Verify Pub/Sub billing-alerts topic exists
Verify budget alert at $50/month on correct billing account
Confirm Gemini key is on claude-code-gws-cli-489903 only

features.description: Documentation update: reflect current state in README and docs
steps: Update README.md tech stack (Runway replaces HeyGen)
Update MEMORY_ARCHITECTURE.md with resolved questions
Add auth middleware to SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md
Verify all file paths in docs match actual structure
